components.title: Core flattening algorithm
components.what: Implement flatten_keys(d: dict) to recursively traverse nested dicts and lists, joining nested dict keys with '.' and list indices as '[i]' appended to the current key.

components.title: Edge cases
components.what: Preserve empty dict or empty list values as-is under their key; assume top-level input is always a dict; all keys are strings; scalar leaves are kept unchanged.

components.title: Deliverable and tests
components.what: Return the complete function definition in one Python code block with imports included, satisfying the visible examples and hidden tests.

log.author: A

challenges.problem: It uses `prefix != ''` to determine whether a container is nested. This incorrectly drops empty containers under a valid empty-string key, e.g. `flatten_keys({'': {}})` returns `{}` instead of `{'': {}}`, and likewise for `{'': []}`. An empty key is allowed because all keys are strings; non-empty is not guaranteed.
